ctx.x: I was going to ask about lawn parties too.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. Well, I used to go to lawn parties up on Taylor Street. I called the lady, called Miss Cole. Yeah, they used to have plenty of lawn parties going on. Every Sunday, they used to have parties. And what I say, they can't have that today on account of the young generation. Too rough. My days, they have all kind of nice parties. Have somewhere to go on Sunday. Just like the lake. You heard talk about Mill and Boy. That was the best place for the colored people to go. That's all the place we had one…
A lot of colored went out there. We had Mill and Boy.
